enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Walk to toilet. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Put comb down.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place frying pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear plate to sink. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Put comb down. Pick up deodorant. Apply deodorant. Put deodorant down. Pick up bag. Put on bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Pull cord. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Swipe card. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to desk. Sit down.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Dial number. Speak on phone. Hang up. Open document. Type report. Print report. Walk to printer. Pick up report. Walk to meeting room. Sit in meeting. Take notes. Speak in meeting. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Open calendar. Schedule appointment.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Stand up. Clear tray. Walk outside. Walk back to office. Sit at desk.

Sit at desk. Open computer. Check emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Meet with community members. Discuss program details. Take notes. Write proposal. Edit document. Print document. Attend meeting. Present ideas. Walk to office. Sit down. Organize files. Update database. Prepare materials for next day.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Pull cord. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Open door. Enter apartment. Close door. Take off shoes. Put down bag. Walk to living room. Sit down.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear plate to sink.

Pick up plate. Scrape food into trash. Put plate in dishwasher. Pick up glass. Put glass in dishwasher. Pick up pan. Wash pan. Rinse pan. Put pan in drying rack. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Pick up book. Read book.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wash face. Dry face. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bed. Pull back covers. Lie down. Pull covers up. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Breathe. Turn to right side. Breathe. Turn to back. Breathe. Remain still.
